## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor rebalancing toward demonstrated leaders in Tech and selective Industrials while monitoring Financials and Energy for signs of stabilization; reduce exposure to lagging Communication and Utilities names. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major-cap divergence suggests tactical sizing and waiting for confirmation before enlarging core positions.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Relative strength from AMD (1W: +26.19% | 1M: +81.62%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +12.36% | 1M: +16.62%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +26.64%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: major-cap divergences (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN showing 1W vs 1M conflict) and headline-driven mismatches (WFC sentiment vs price) — watch for trend breaks before enlarging exposure.
